## Description

Day view with columns per doctor/resource and time rows; week view per doctor; list view (agenda) for mobile and printing. Appointment chips show name, type, time and state with icon + label (Booked, Checked in, In room, Completed, No-show dashed, Cancelled dashed, Unavailable hatched). Doctor filter, date navigation, today button. Doctors see their own schedule view (read-only booking actions per permissions).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Calendar first render < 2.5 s on a clinic PC over throttled 4G for a 3-doctor day (Lighthouse/Playwright perf budget).
- [ ] **AC2.** States are distinguishable without colour (icon + label) and announced to screen readers; empty slots are buttons with accessible names like "Book Dr. Arjun Rao at 10:20".
- [ ] **AC3.** Week and list views show the same appointments as day view (consistency test).
- [ ] **AC4.** At ≤ 767 px the list/agenda view is the default with a pinned "+ Book" action.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
